hero.subtitle: Helping patients from Iraq and the UAE access trusted healthcare in India.
hero.description: When you or someone you love needs medical treatment, choosing where to go can feel overwhelming.
questions: Which hospital is right for your condition?
How do you manage everything when you are travelling to another country?
hero.content: IBN Sina is here to make that journey easier. With operations in Iraq, the UAE, and India, we help patients connect with suitable doctors, hospitals, and healthcare services in India.

about.title: Healthcare Should Not Feel Complicated
paragraphs: Travelling to another country for medical treatment is a big decision.

For patients and their families, it is not only about finding a hospital. It is about finding the right medical expertise, understanding the available options, communicating comfortably, and knowing that someone is there when you need help.
That is where IBN Sina comes in.
We act as a bridge between patients in Iraq and the UAE and healthcare providers in India.
We listen to your needs, help coordinate your medical case, connect you with appropriate healthcare professionals, and support you through the practical side of your treatment journey.
about.quote: One patient. One family. One journey at a time.

items.title: A Human Point of Contact
items.description: Healthcare can be confusing, especially when you are far from home. Our team helps you understand the process and guides you through the next steps.

items.title: Access to Medical Expertise
items.description: We help international patients explore suitable doctors and hospitals in India according to their medical requirements.

items.title: Support Before You Travel
items.description: Your journey starts long before you board a flight. We help coordinate medical records, specialist consultations, hospital appointments, and treatment planning.

items.title: Support When You Arrive
items.description: From hospital coordination to local assistance, our team helps make your stay more manageable.

items.title: Support After Treatment
items.description: Our relationship does not have to end when you leave the hospital. We can help coordinate follow-up requirements and continued communication.
